newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alex. Brown starts Kellstrom.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alex. Brown starts Kellstrom.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said analyst Christopher Mecray initiated coverage of Kellstrom Industries Inc with a strong buy.
-- said Kellstrom, a supplier of aftermarket jet engines and engine parts, is positioned for growth from ongoing aviation market strength and consolidation of parts supply market.
-- said company to grow from IASI acquisition and continued internal product expansion.
-- set six to 12 month price target of $20.
-- estimates 1997 earnings $1.05 a shre, compared to $0.89 in 1996.
-- Kellstrom traded up 3/4 to 14 at midday.
